html:
In the next few days, I will be opening my free Beta Reader program for the third Jack and Janet prequel titled DEADMAN WALKING.  For those of you who would like to read and provide general comments on the same rough draft I will be sending to my publisher (not yet edited), I will be glad to push a free copy to your kindle or kindle app.  To participate, send an email to Richard.phillips@secondship.net and let me know your kindle’s email address.  It will look like this:  something@kindle.com
Best,
Richard

Richard

replies.author: Richard Phillips

All I expect from my Beta Readers is to read the draft and let me know what you thought of the story. If some error jumps out at you then let me know but don’t worry about typos and such, my copy editor will catch that.
Best,
Richard
